passages.note: Operative section requires written parental permission before staff use a different pronoun or first name; it names no exception that lets staff proceed without it.

rows.reasoning: He is prime sponsor of and voted Y on single-subject SB 1001 (2023), whose operative section bars staff from using a pronoun or first name other than the one on record unless the school receives written permission from the student's parent. That matches 'Require written parental permission before staff use a student's chosen name or pronouns' on written, parental and before-use clauses, and the bill allows permission, so it is not past the rung.
